scope: Image branch only; live control unchanged
ownership: Exactly one async environment setup task per pending setup; strong source CGImage capture until generation returns, no scene construction/mutation/GPU submission while awaiting. Latest pending input replaces prior input. Completion installs resource only while active and not failed, then drains current request. Frame retains renderer/resource through GPU and conversion as before.
publicationCancellation: Disappear invalidates active/publication/pending; no claim that underlying resource-generation work is cancellable. Completion while inactive is recorded/discarded.
failure: CGImage or resource generation throws -> unavailable; no retry/timer/fallback image.
limits: Fixed neutral white is a declared appearance adaptation, not Apple default or system IBL reconstruction
One fixed candidate; no brightness/exposure search
Source image dimensions are representation choice, no reference pixels measured
Async generation latency and actual visual readability require bounded runtime evidence
